## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [師會](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B8%AB%E6%9C%83) Shīhuì (active 12th c.) — the Southern-Sòng Yùfēng-monastery Huáyán-school authority — is a programmatic statement of the doctrine of *róng huì yī chéng* 融會一乘 ("perfect-integration of the One-Vehicle") and its lineage in the Huáyán-school doctrinal tradition.

**Abstract**

The work is precisely datable through Shīhuì's biographical notice (DILA A000915) to *Qiándào* 乾道 7 (1171 CE). The bracket adopted here (1171 – 1171) reflects this exact dating. The doctrinal substance — the *róng huì yī chéng* doctrine and its lineage from Fǎzàng to the Sòng — places the work in the same intellectual milieu as Shīhuì's better-known commentaries on the *[Wǔ jiào zhāng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0074)* (*[Fén xīn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0076)*, *[Kē](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0077)*, *[Fù gǔ jì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0078)*).

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X985) collection.
